title: 10 Best Calamintha Ascendens Preparations

Tinctures provide a concentrated form of the herb, ideal for quick absorption and targeted use. Capsules offer a convenient and standardized way to consume the herb’s active compounds. Oils extracted from the plant are often used in aromatherapy and topical applications for their calming and healing properties.
